faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: When can we start?
delivery.answer: After the brand analysis and strategy phase, we typically present the first content calendar within 7-10 days.

pricing.question: How do packages work?
pricing.answer: Packages vary by number of platforms, monthly content volume and ad management needs. Custom proposal after a free call.

revisions.question: Can I approve content before it goes live?
revisions.answer: Yes. All content is submitted for your approval before publishing. We make any requested changes.

maintenance.question: What is the minimum contract length?
maintenance.answer: Social media management is a long-term process. We work with a minimum 3-month agreement. Monthly continuation is possible afterwards.

migration.question: Can you take over my existing accounts?
migration.answer: Yes. We're ready to analyze your existing Instagram, TikTok or LinkedIn accounts and strategically take over management.

mobile.question: Does ad spend come from my own account?
mobile.answer: Yes. Ad spend comes directly from your own account. We only handle campaign setup and management.
